panel.title: GitHub Feed
panel.search-placeholder: Filter by user, repo, or keyword…
panel.no-watchers: Watch a GitHub user below to build your feed.
panel.empty-hint: Log in with gh auth login (or set your username + token in settings) for your full homepage feed, or watch a user above.

settings.github-username-desc: Override for the device login. Leave empty to use whoever is signed in via gh auth login.
settings.github-token-desc: Override for the gh token. A fine-grained token with no extra permissions works. Leave empty to use gh.
settings.show-count-in-bar-desc: Display the number of feed items beside the bar icon.

errors.fetch: Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
errors.auth: GitHub rejected the request. Check your username and token.
errors.not-found: A watched user was not found on GitHub.
errors.max-watched: You can watch up to 20 users.
